Vivillon's form is locked to Fancy Form in this game, with other forms needing transfer.
You can temporarily change the form that appears in your game for Scatterbug, Spewpa and Vivillon caught within 24 hours by sending a postcard from the respective region from Pokémon GO to Pokémon Scarlet & Violet. The default form changes back to Fancy Pattern afterwards
